title: The Final Puzzle - Part 5
description: [Part 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543159) | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | Part 5 | [Part 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541737) A secret message is revealed when putting the [Severed Hand](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541734#L) under the microscope and completing the minigame. GGC AAG AUA ACG UGU CAU

title: The Final Puzzle - Part 6
description: [Part 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543159) | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | Part 6 G is the Sun - a sticker on the side of [this microscope](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541024#L) says G = 15000000000, and the sun is around that distance from the earth. C is Star - the [Grace Ashcroft Blood Analysis Report](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541759#L) file mentions 'C = 4.2ly', and the closest star to Earth (Alpha Centauri) is around 4.2 light years away. U is Moon - letting the sand trickle through the [hourglass](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541742#L) reveals a message saying U = 380,000, the distance between Earth and the moon. Part 4 told us to 'just ignore A', so when we translate the sequence, the code is: - Sun, Sun, Star - Sun, Moon, Star - Sun, Moon, Sun - Moon, Star, Moon Enter the code into the [Sun Puzzle Box](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541204) while holding Emily and [the doll from part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157), and you'll hear a creepy laugh - the puzzle is now complete. Pretty stupid, huh?

title: The Final Puzzle - Part 4
description: [Part 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543159) | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | Part 4 | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | [Part 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541737) After kicking a head through a hoop in the [basketball court](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541027#L), returning to this bobblehead torso will trigger a secret message - 'Just Ignore A' - that'll make more sense in the next step.

title: The Final Puzzle - Part 3
description: [Part 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543159) | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | Part 3 | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | [Part 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541737) Marie's Doll suddenly appears here after completing the previous two parts. title: The Final Puzzle - Part 1
description: Part 1 | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | [Part 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541737) Before you drain the liquid, stand by the side of the pool for around 20 minutes. After that, drain the liquid, but don't kill any zombies yourself - let them all die to the grinder. We're not 100% sure _why_ this is part of the solution, but the [Subject 170 Record](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541757) mentions 115 infected being used to collect 524.3 litres of blood, and corpses are flowing into the pool here. 15-20 minutes is plenty of time to generate all that blood.

title: The Final Puzzle - Part 2
description: [Part 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543159) | Part 2 | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | [Part 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541737) Flush the toilet 8 times.
